summary.text: Bill Blessing, listed by the Ohio Senate as Louis W. Blessing, III, is a member of the Ohio Senate, representing District 8, which covers a portion of Hamilton County. The Senate's biography says he is serving his second term and began his legislative career in the Ohio House, representing the 29th House District.

paragraphs.text: The Senate's biography says Blessing has a background in electrical engineering and works as an engineer at Super Systems, Inc. in Cincinnati, after earlier work at Duke Energy and Nova Engineering.
It says he earned a bachelor of arts in mathematics and a bachelor of science in electrical engineering at the University of Cincinnati and is a licensed professional engineer.
The biography lists him as vice chair of the Senate Education Committee in the 136th General Assembly.
It says he lives in Colerain Township with his wife, Heather, and their three sons.
